products.name: Ember Wired Gamepad
products.blurb: Translucent red shell, rubberised grips, zero pairing.
products.description: A plug-in controller for PC and console emulators that just works: no batteries, no Bluetooth dropouts, no input lag. Twin vibration motors sit under textured grips, and the translucent shell shows off the board inside.
highlights: Works with Windows, Android OTG and PS3

products.name: Prism Mechanical Keyboard
products.blurb: Full-size board with a rainbow edge glow and swappable switches.
products.description: A full 104-key layout on a brushed aluminium top plate. The edge light wraps the whole case, and the hot-swap sockets mean you can try different switches without picking up a soldering iron.

products.name: Curve 27 Gaming Monitor
products.blurb: 1500R curved VA panel at 165 Hz with a 1 ms response.
products.description: A gentle 1500R curve keeps the corners of the screen in your field of view. The VA panel gives deep blacks for night scenes, and 165 Hz keeps fast games smooth without a top-end graphics card.

products.name: Linden Lounge Chair
products.blurb: A tall, wing-backed seat on solid ash legs.
products.description: The Linden is a dining-height chair that sits like a lounge chair. A curved wing back supports your shoulders, the seat is sprung rather than just foamed, and the legs are solid ash finished with a matte oil.

products.name: Weekender Canvas Duffle
products.blurb: Coated canvas, leather trim and a striped web band.
products.description: Sized for two nights away and still fits most overhead bins. The coated canvas wipes clean, the handles are full-grain leather, and there's a detachable shoulder strap for when your hands are full.

products.name: Coral Field Parka
products.blurb: A four-pocket hooded parka in a bright, rain-ready shell.
products.description: A loose-fitting field parka with a contrast-lined hood and four big bellows pockets. The shell is water-resistant and breathable, so it works for a wet commute and a dry hike.

products.name: Halo 240 Liquid Cooler
products.blurb: 240 mm all-in-one CPU cooler with ring-lit fans.
products.description: A sealed, pre-filled liquid loop for Intel and AMD sockets. Two 120 mm fans push air through the radiator quietly, and the pump head's light ring syncs with most motherboard lighting software.

products.name: Oakline Side Table
products.blurb: A C-shaped oak table that slides over the sofa arm.
products.description: Half side table, half bookshelf. The cantilevered top slides over a sofa arm or bed edge for a laptop or a cup of tea, and the lower shelf holds a stack of paperbacks. Solid oak with tapered legs.

products.name: Filet Recipe Dry Dog Food
products.blurb: Beef-flavour kibble with vegetables for small breeds.
products.description: Complete, balanced dry food made for small dogs, with real beef as the first ingredient and carrots and peas for fibre. The kibble is small enough for little jaws.

products.name: Snapshot DSLR Kit 18–55 mm
products.blurb: 24 MP beginner DSLR with a stabilised kit zoom.
products.description: A light, friendly DSLR with a guided menu that explains each setting as you change it. The 18–55 mm kit lens is stabilised, and Wi-Fi sends photos straight to your phone.

products.name: Nightline 15 Gaming Laptop
products.blurb: 15.6" 144 Hz laptop with an RTX-class GPU and blue-lit keys.
products.description: A no-nonsense gaming laptop: a 144 Hz screen, a dedicated graphics card and a cooling system with four exhaust vents, in a matte black chassis that doesn't shout in a lecture hall.

products.name: Roadster Kids' Ride-On
products.blurb: 12 V electric sports car with a parent remote.
products.description: A two-speed electric ride-on for ages 3 to 6. Parents can take over with the 2.4 GHz remote, the doors open, the headlights work, and a soft-start motor stops sudden jolts.

products.name: Volt Firm-Ground Boots
products.blurb: Soft leather upper and a bladed stud plate for grass.
products.description: A leather-forefoot boot that feels broken in from the first session. The bladed firm-ground plate grips natural grass, and the padded heel stops blisters on long training nights.

products.name: Shadow Wireless Gamepad
products.blurb: Tri-mode controller: 2.4 GHz, Bluetooth or cable.
products.description: One controller for PC, phone and Switch. It connects over a low-latency 2.4 GHz dongle, Bluetooth or USB-C, and the Hall-effect sticks won't drift the way cheaper pads do.

products.name: Spruce Bomber Jacket
products.blurb: Deep green satin bomber with a flash-orange lining.
products.description: A classic flight-jacket shape in a deep spruce satin, lined in bright orange so it can be turned inside out for a louder day. Ribbed collar, cuffs and hem keep the wind out.

products.name: Aurora 6 Pro
products.blurb: Triple 48 MP cameras in a deep violet steel frame.
products.description: Our flagship pick of the season. The triple camera handles low light without a tripod, the 6.1-inch OLED hits 2000 nits outdoors, and the steel frame is finished in a deep violet that shifts with the light.
